summary: Akzo Nobel N.V. and Axalta Coating Systems Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing enhancements to governance arrangements for their pending all-share merger of equals. Changes include annual re-election of all directors after the initial three-year period (versus five years previously) and reducing the approval threshold for certain board actions from 75% to two-thirds during the same period. No changes to deal terms, price, or timeline were required; the EGM and SGM remain scheduled for August 5, 2026. This reflects shareholder engagement and does not alter the transaction structure. Watch for shareholder vote outcomes and regulatory clearance.
